description: This file defines the CandidateActionHistory class within the OrangeHRM recruitment module. It provides methods to retrieve accessible candidate action history IDs and subset IDs for interviewers, utilizing constants from CandidateService and WorkflowStateMachine.

classes.name: CandidateActionHistory
classes.description: Contains methods to retrieve candidate action history IDs with access control based on candidate service maps and workflow actions.

methods.name: getAccessibleCandidateActionHistoryIds
methods.description: Returns array of IDs representing all accessible candidate action histories by combining status maps.

methods.name: getAccessibleCandidateHistoryIdsForInterviewer
methods.description: Returns array of IDs for candidate actions accessible to interviewers, excluding certain actions such as hire, decline, offer, and reject.
